highlights: Cutting-edge research is rapidly advancing LLM efficiency and reliability, with breakthroughs in accelerating long-context inference and robustly detecting hallucinations.
AI agents are proving increasingly capable in complex domains, from revolutionizing chip design and drug discovery to providing critical frameworks for secure and governed deployment.

Leading AI companies are expanding their ecosystem through new industry-specific platforms, critical developer tools, and broad learning initiatives to accelerate adoption and ensure responsible AI development.

agents.title: Agents Design Better Chips with Higher-Level Abstraction
agents.summary: This research demonstrates that LLM agents can achieve a 2.6x speedup in chip design by leveraging higher-level abstractions, showcasing a promising workflow for agentic hardware development.

agents.title: Agentic Molecule Optimization for Binding Specificity (SpecOpt)
agents.summary: SpecOpt introduces an agentic framework for molecular design that improves drug binding specificity by analyzing differential atom-protein contacts, enabling targeted modifications to existing compounds for enhanced selectivity.

agents.title: AI-GRACE Framework for Agentic AI Operationalization
agents.summary: AI-GRACE provides a comprehensive framework for organizations to operationalize agentic AI, connecting governance, risk, and assurance with technical deployment capabilities to ensure outcomes meet obligations.

models.title: RBS-Attention: Sparse Prefill for Long-Context LLMs
models.summary: RBS-Attention introduces a training-free sparse-prefill method that significantly speeds up long-context LLM inference by up to 20x on H100 GPUs, addressing a critical bottleneck for large-scale deployments.

models.title: Attention-Aware Routing in MoEs
models.summary: Attention-Aware Routing (AAR) augments Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models by coupling routing with attention weights, improving performance (e.g., +3.37 pp on GSM8K) and reducing long diverging generations by training only routing parameters.

models.title: Detecting Hallucination via Attention Graph Topology
models.summary: This work introduces a single-pass method to detect hallucinations in LLMs by analyzing topological signatures of impaired context sharing within attention graphs, offering consistent improvements over existing baselines across various models.

tools.title: Hugging Face tokenizers v1 Released
tools.summary: Hugging Face releases version 1 of its `tokenizers` library, bringing improved encode, decode, and scaling capabilities essential for efficient and robust text processing in LLM pipelines.

tools.title: Hugging Face Introduces @huggingface/kernels for Local AI
tools.summary: Hugging Face launches `huggingface/kernels`, a collection of over 200 WebGPU kernels, empowering developers to run local AI inference with optimized performance directly within web browsers.

tools.title: Google Pics: AI Image Creation and Editing in Workspace
tools.summary: Google introduces 'Google Pics,' a new AI-powered tool built on the Nano Banana model for easy image creation and editing, now available directly within Google Workspace.

companies.title: OpenAI Introduces Astra for Law
companies.summary: OpenAI launches 'Astra for Law,' bringing frontier intelligence, custom firm workflows, connected legal data sources, and legal-grade controls specifically tailored for confidential client work in the legal sector.

companies.title: OpenAI Outlines Global AI Standards Path
companies.summary: OpenAI outlines a path towards shared global AI standards, advocating for coordinated evaluation, reporting, and governance to enhance the safety and responsible development of advanced AI.

companies.title: OpenAI Forms Mathematics and AI Advisory Group
companies.summary: OpenAI establishes an independent Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence to guide the review and communication of emerging AI research, signaling a commitment to scientific rigor and transparency.

learning.title: OpenAI Academy Expands with New Learning Paths
learning.summary: OpenAI Academy is expanding its offerings with new learning paths designed for employees, developers, leaders, educators, and students to build and demonstrate practical AI skills.

learning.title: ChatGPT Workshops for Older Adults with AARP
learning.summary: OpenAI and AARP are partnering to offer free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to 1,000 older adults across 10 U.S. cities, aiming to build practical AI skills safely and enhance digital literacy.

learning.title: DevFest 2026: Build in the Agentic AI Era
learning.summary: Google's DevFest 2026 is back with over 800 global events focused on helping developers build, secure, and scale solutions in the agentic AI era, offering significant learning and networking opportunities.
